# Kalaa

> Technology growth partner. Kalaa runs social media, content and paid
> campaigns, builds websites and software, and reports what the work returned.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kalaa.io/): What Kalaa does, and who it is for.
- [Services](https://kalaa.io/services): The six services in full. Social media
  management, campaign management, content creation, website and software
  development, business growth strategy, brand strategy and design.
- [Blog](https://kalaa.io/blog): Articles on social media, content, advertising
  and branding for businesses.
- [How Aesthetic Design Can Transform Your Brand](https://kalaa.io/blog/how-aesthetic-design-can-transform-your-brand):
  How colour, lighting, texture and minimalism shape a brand's visual identity,
  and how to apply them in different industries.
- [Contact](https://kalaa.io/contact): How to reach Kalaa. Email, WhatsApp and
  the office address in Surat, Gujarat.
- [Privacy policy](https://kalaa.io/privacy-policy): What personal data Kalaa
  collects, how it is used, how long it is kept, and your rights over it.

## Notes

- Contact: hey@kalaa.io for anything else, privacy@kalaa.io for anything about
  personal data.
- Keep this file in step with `src/routes.ts`. A page added there without a line
  here is invisible to the answer engines that read this file rather than
  crawling the site.
